comment: Gravity and a hanging hose (mitcad#1713), tools/ui-gravity-test.sh and tools/ui-windows-gravity-test.ps1: a 200 x 80 x 10 plate (Box1, body F1.b0, its top at z = 10), a step on it (Box2, body F2.b0, x 0..60, its top at z = 22), a plank above the step's edge (Box3, body F3.b0, 90 x 30 x 8, x 30..120, y 25..55, z 70..78) and a hose 6 thick (Flex1, F4, body F4.b0) in an S from a free end at 100 above the step's far side, up over n2 and down under n3, to a free end at 120 above the plate's far end, about 215 long between ends 171 apart; the S is symmetric about its middle, so that the middle of its bounds (where the view logs the body, which a click there picks) lies on it. Let hang from its ends, its middle falls onto the plank and lies on it.
